verdict.rationale: NotebookLM can generate briefings, source-guide summaries, slide decks, and infographics from sources, and users can export notes to Google Docs/Sheets or share notebooks publicly with stakeholders (docs-3, docs-5, docs-13, docs-19, docs-8). However, there is no explicit documentation of a single 'report' format containing structured sections plus tables in one output — tables aren't mentioned at all, and community feedback focuses on audio/podcast quirks rather than confirming report quality. missing for 10: explicit table generation, a dedicated 'report' template combining sections+tables+summary, and independent validation of report usability for stakeholders.
